gui.industrial_platform.build.missing_ma: Put a material into the slot first
industrial_platform.configuration.adjust: Extra items that cycle the platform type on right-click and show the block boundary preview while held. Use #namespace:path for tags or namespace:path for item IDs. The Fill Adjuster is built in. Default: #c:tools/wrench.
industrial_platform.configuration.bottom: Initial downward fill distance in the builder screen. Players can change it in the screen. Default: 5 blocks.
industrial_platform.configuration.cost.t: Base material costs for standard and heavy platforms, plus the extra cost per filled layer.
industrial_platform.configuration.fillin: Extra material items consumed for each layer filled upward or downward. Added to the base platform cost. Default: 0.
industrial_platform.configuration.genera: Materials, additional adjusters and default fill distances. Restart the server or client after changing these settings.
industrial_platform.configuration.heavy_: Base number of material items consumed by a heavy platform build. Increase it to make heavy platforms more expensive. Default: 1.
industrial_platform.configuration.light_: Base number of material items consumed by a standard platform build. Default: 1.
industrial_platform.configuration.max_pl: Largest allowed platform footprint, in chunks per side. Default: 4 (64 × 64 blocks).
industrial_platform.configuration.min_pl: Smallest allowed platform footprint, in chunks per side. Default: 1.
industrial_platform.configuration.platfo: Minimum and maximum platform size, in chunks per side.

Items accepted by the builder material slot. Use #namespace:path for tags or namespace:path for item IDs. The industrial_platform:platform_material item tag is also accepted. Defaults: #c:stones, minecraft:cobblestone.
industrial_platform.configuration.title: Industrial Platform Configuration
industrial_platform.configuration.top_fi: Initial upward fill distance in the builder screen. Players can change it in the screen. Default: 5 blocks.
jei.info.industrial_platform.fluid_pool:
Right click with any stone to deploy the infinite pool
Stand besides the block with a wrench or the fill adjuster in hand to display preview
Fluid Pools will not remove blocks above
The pool is over 10,000 blocks, which supports infinite fluid in Create
jei.info.industrial_platform.platform:
Sneak + right click a platform block with an empty hand to open the platform builder
Hold a wrench or the fill adjuster to display the block boundary preview
Adjust the fill height and choose the style / size in the screen
Put a material into the slot, then press Build to deploy the platform
